mapper.select: SELECT pa.id, pa.product_id, pd.id AS parentSkuId, pd.sku_no AS parentSkuNo, pd.images_url AS parentSkuImagesUrl, pa.quantity, pa.accessories_sku_id FROM product_detail pd LEFT JOIN product_accessories pa ON pa.parent_sku_id=pd.id AND pa.is_deleted=false WHERE pd.product_id=#{productId} AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE
